name: setreuid32
description: Sets the real and/or effective user ID of the calling process, supporting 32-bit IDs. Supplying -1 for either ID leaves it unchanged, with restrictions for unprivileged processes.

parameters.name: ruid
parameters.description: The real user ID to set, or -1 to leave unchanged.

parameters.name: euid
parameters.description: The effective user ID to set, or -1 to leave unchanged.

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: The call would change the caller’s real UID, but there was a temporary failure or resource limit issue.
One or more of the target user IDs is not valid in this user namespace.
The calling process is not privileged and a disallowed change was specified.
